title: Qman DirectPath Correctable-only AER policy candidate
description: Closed, target-code-independent policy bytes for the Correctable-only AER component premise. This schema does not prove repository currentness, VFIO enforcement, physical recovery, E4 qualification, or product authorization.

extendedCapability.x-qmanIndependenceRule: headerExposure and bodyExposure are independent policy choices. Hiding the Extended Capability header never silently selects the body projection, and hiding the body never silently rewires the capability chain.

x-qmanDigestRule: Deep-copy the complete schema-valid policy, set aerPolicyDigest to null only in the construction projection, encode that projection with CANONICAL-JSON-V1, prepend the exact x-qmanDigestDomain bytes, and SHA-256 the result. The final document carries sha256:<64 lowercase hex>.
x-qmanSemanticVerifierRule: A conforming verifier checks every read mask is a subset of its field allow-mask; physical and shadow W1C masks are disjoint and V1 assigns a field wholly to at most one W1C owner; W1C masks are subsets of both the field W1C allow-mask and guestReadAllowMask; DENY owns no W1C bits; FILTERED_W1C is restricted to the three W1C fields; a hidden AER body forwards no physical write; physical W1C requires an effective PHYSICAL projection; shadow W1C requires an effective SHADOW projection; Root Status and Correctable Source use the same effective projection.
x-qmanUncorrectableRule: A write overlapping AER relative bytes 0x04 through 0x0f (Uncorrectable Status, Mask, or Severity) is denied as one complete access. No unknown byte lane gains physical read or write authority.
x-qmanSourceRule: The low 16-bit Correctable Source storage may be projected as raw storage, but requester attribution is semantically valid only while Root Error Status.COR_RCV is set.
